fullTextEN: Hello everyone!
I am Teacher Wang.
Today I am especially happy,
because we meet again!

fullTextZH: 上次的故事你们还记得吗？
fullTextEN: Do you still remember the last story?

fullTextZH: 唐僧和孙悟空有了白龙马，
fullTextEN: Tang Monk and Sun Wukong got the White Dragon Horse,
They traveled very fast.
They arrived at a place,
This place is a village.
In this village,
they met two people:

fullTextZH: 一个年轻人和一位老爷爷。
fullTextEN: a young man and an old grandpa.
There is a monster in the old grandpa's house,

fullTextZH: 好心的孙悟空要帮助老爷爷打妖怪。
fullTextEN: Kind-hearted Sun Wukong wants to help the old grandpa fight the monster.

fullTextZH: 老爷爷告诉孙悟空，他有一个漂亮的女儿。
fullTextEN: The old grandpa told Sun Wukong that he has a beautiful daughter.

fullTextZH: 他给女儿找了一个丈夫
fullTextEN: He found a husband for his daughter
This man is very strong

fullTextZH: 他帮助老爷爷做了很多工作，
fullTextEN: He helped the old grandpa with a lot of work,

fullTextZH: 给了老爷爷很多的帮助。
fullTextEN: and gave the old grandpa a lot of help.

fullTextZH: 老爷爷觉得他给女儿找了一个好丈夫，
fullTextEN: The old grandpa feels he found a good husband for his daughter,
Really like him.

fullTextZH: 但是这个人吃的非常多！
fullTextEN: But this person eats a lot!

fullTextZH: 一顿饭能吃 100 多个馒头。
fullTextEN: In one meal, he can eat over 100 buns.

fullTextZH: 孙悟空听了，哈哈哈笑了：
fullTextEN: Sun Wukong listened and laughed:

fullTextZH: 「他一个人做了几十个人的工作，
fullTextEN: "He did the work of dozens of people alone,
of course he eats a lot!
How can you say he is a monster?"
The old man said: "Don't worry,
listen to me finish.

fullTextZH: 开始的时候这个男的好好的，
fullTextEN: At first, this man was fine,

fullTextZH: 后来我发现这个人的脸会变！
fullTextEN: later I found this person's face could change!

fullTextZH: 它的耳朵变得又大又圆，
fullTextEN: Its ears became big and round,
the nose grew longer,
the mouth also became bigger,
like a black pig!
He is not human,
he is a monster!
I found many people to fight the monster,
hoping he would leave my home.
But this monster is also powerful,
And there are weapons,
The people in the village are all very scared,
They don't dare to fight this monster anymore.
The monster got angry,
He doesn't let my daughter go out,
nor does he let her go downstairs.

fullTextZH: 我已经几个月没见过我的女儿了！」
fullTextEN: I haven't seen my daughter for several months!"
Sun Wukong told the old man:
"Don't worry,
I'll help you fight the monster!"

fullTextZH: 孙悟空飞进了女儿的房间，
fullTextEN: Sun Wukong flew into the daughter's room,

fullTextZH: 让女儿快离开，自己变成了女儿的样子。
fullTextEN: told the daughter to leave quickly, and turned into her appearance.
It's getting dark,
The monster is coming back!

fullTextZH: 孙悟空变的女儿说：「今天我爸爸找了一个很厉害的人来打你，
fullTextEN: The daughter transformed by Sun Wukong said: "Today my dad found a very powerful person to fight you,
His name is Sun Wukong!"

fullTextZH: 妖怪听到孙悟空这个名字就想走。
fullTextEN: When the monster heard the name Sun Wukong, it wanted to leave.
The daughter transformed by Sun Wukong said:
He wants to leave with the monster.
The monster's home is on a mountain,
Sun Wukong transformed into a daughter,
made the monster carry him up the mountain.

fullTextZH: 孙悟空让自己的身体越来越重，
fullTextEN: Sun Wukong made his body heavier and heavier,
The monster got more and more tired climbing.

fullTextZH: 妖怪要去树下休息休息，
fullTextEN: The monster wanted to rest under a tree,

fullTextZH: 这个时候，孙悟空变的女儿问妖怪：
fullTextEN: At this moment, the daughter Sun Wukong transformed into asked the monster:

fullTextZH: 「你为什么听见孙悟空这个名字这么害怕？」
fullTextEN: "Why are you so afraid when you hear the name Sun Wukong?"
The monster told him:
"He used to be a celestial being,

fullTextZH: 因为在生日派对上喝了太多的酒，
fullTextEN: because he drank too much wine at a birthday party,
did something wrong,
and eventually turned into a monster."
This monster had seen Sun Wukong,
and knew Sun Wukong was very powerful.

fullTextZH: 孙悟空变成了自己的样子，
fullTextEN: Sun Wukong turned back into his own form,
The monster saw it was Sun Wukong,
and was very scared,
wanting to run away quickly.

fullTextZH: 孙悟空拿着金箍棒打妖怪，
fullTextEN: Sun Wukong hit the monster with his golden staff,
The monster also had a weapon,

fullTextZH: 他的武器是一个九齿钉耙！
fullTextEN: His weapon is a nine-toothed rake!
This weapon has nine teeth,
and it's very powerful.
They fought for a long time,
The monster was exhausted.
He said to Sun Wukong:
I was wrong,
I'm sorry!
Will Sun Wukong keep hitting him?
What will happen in the end?
Next time I will tell you,
Goodbye!
